integration_removed.description:
The Plum Lightpad integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__.

The required cloud services are no longer available since the Plum servers have been shut down. To resolve this issue, please remove the (now defunct) integration entries from your __HA_KEEP__ setup. [View your existing Plum Lightpad integration entries]({entries}).
integration_removed.title: The Plum Lightpad integration has been removed
